<!--
Geographic distribution
1. Country table
2. Map of distribution (interactive if html)
-->



```{r countries_text, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (is.null(params$countries)) {
  country_list <- paste0("Geographical distribution was not requested")
  country_text <- ""
} else {
  country_list <- paste0("**Countries:** ", params$countries$Country)
  country_text <- paste0(
"From the most recent ", max(params$years), " classification, the ecosystem is found in the following countries: ", params$countries$Country, ". The area and percentage of the ecosystem within each country as measured in ",max(params$years), " is summarised in the table and map below:")
}
```

`r country_list`

`r country_text`

```{r coo, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$countries), results='asis'}
coo_df <- params$countries
title_text <- "Percentage of ROI occurrence per country"

# display the table
if (knitr::is_html_output()) 
{
  htmltools::tagList(
    # centered Title
    htmltools::div(
      style = "text-align:center; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;", title_text),
    DT::datatable(coo_df, rownames=F,
                  escape = FALSE,
                  options = list(
                  paging = FALSE,
                  searching = FALSE,
                  info = FALSE,
                  dom = 't',
                  autoWidth = TRUE,
                  scrollX = FALSE)) %>%
      DT::formatStyle(columns = c(1:ncol(coo_df)), fontSize = '100%')
)
  
  } else {

  # flextable
  set_flextable_defaults(
    font.size = 10, theme_fun = theme_vanilla, padding = 5, background.color = "transparent"
  )
  
  coo_tab <- flextable(coo_df) %>%
    set_caption(caption = as_paragraph(as_b(title_text))) %>%
    autofit() %>%
    flextable::theme_booktabs(bold_header = TRUE) %>%
    # colformat_num(j="Year", big.mark = "") %>%
    set_table_properties(layout="autofit")
  
  coo_tab
  
  }
```

  
```{r eu_map, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,  fig.align = "center", out.width = '100%', eval = !is.null(params$countries)}
map_title <- paste0("Distribution of the ecosystem in ", max(years))

#if (!is.null(params$rasters)) {
  r_recent <- try(rasters[[length(rasters)]], silent = TRUE) # get the most recent raster for plotting
  
  # the map - recent raster only
  pal <- colorNumeric(palette = c("white", "black"), domain = c(1, 0), na.color = "transparent")
  
  # get eau extent for mapping zoom
  ext_r <- as.vector(ext(r_recent)) 
   
   m <- leaflet() %>%
    addTiles() %>%
      fitBounds(unname(ext_r["xmin"]),
                    unname(ext_r["ymin"]),
                    unname(ext_r["xmax"]),
                    unname(ext_r["ymax"])) %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "ESRI Satellite") %>%
    addRasterImage(r_recent, group = paste0(max(years), " classification"), colors = pal, method = "ngb", project = TRUE) %>% 
    addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("OSM", "ESRI Satellite"),
                     overlayGroups = c(paste0(max(years), " classification")),
                     options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))
  
  # plot the map
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  
     # Wrap the map with title
    htmltools::tagList(
      tags$div(
        style = "text-align:center; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;", map_title),
      m)
    
  } else{
    htmlwidgets::saveWidget(m, "map.html")
webshot("map.html", file = "map.png", vwidth = 800, vheight = 600)
knitr::include_graphics("map.png")
  }
```
